resources.string: Needed by a client that sends doses (POST /add_treatments) or reads the history (/api/v1/events): header X-DiaPilot-Token, Authorization: Bearer, or ?token=. The watch face feed /info.json is unchanged and needs nothing. The token belongs to this installation and is stored encrypted.
The token could not be created on this phone, so those two endpoints stay closed.
Fill this in if your xDrip has an api-secret configured (Settings → Inter-app settings). It is sent hashed, as xDrip expects, and is stored encrypted. Leave it empty if you did not set one.
